aws.route53.health_check.AWS.note: Health check of an AWS endpoint (and calculated, CloudWatch metric and recovery control checks). Always free: the first 50 a month (https://aws.amazon.com/free/, Always free: Amazon Route 53, "Up to 50 AWS endpoints for health checks"), given by the Price List as a $0 first tier and counted over the account

aws.route53.health_check.Non-AWS.note: Health check of an endpoint outside AWS; no free checks

aws.route53.health_check_option.note: Optional feature of a health check (HTTPS, string matching, fast interval, latency measurement)
